summary: In Upper Snohomish / Skykomish watershed, Washington, Tulalip Beaver Relocation is a monitoring and adaptive management initiative. The documented approach is to relocate nuisance beavers from developed areas to hydrologically impaired tributaries or public land to support fish habitat and water storage. The cited material connects the relocation work to warming and drying climate. Historical relocation and wildlife-camera monitoring are documented. The available materials do not identify an independent measured project outcome.
